content: The Diehl-Martinez-Kamalu Loss is a weighted combination of a binary cross entropy loss with a dot-product attention metric of each user-defined keyword with the model’s generated output. Formally, the binary cross entropy (BCE) loss for one example is defined as: $ BCE(x,y) = y \cdot logx + (1-y) \cdot log(1-x), $
